subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core support identity-linked token usage reporting for billing and quota workflows, and what identity is the supported accounting key?
rationale: Current docs frame Gateway auth as trusted operator access rather than per-user tenancy, and adding user accounting would create new privacy, security, and product semantics beyond existing session/model/provider usage reports.

options.title: Design core user accounting first
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned design that chooses the identity key, retention model, access rules, and core dashboard/API scope before implementation.

options.title: Route to external telemetry or plugin
options.body: Treat billing/quota reporting as an integration concern and add only any missing generic usage export or plugin API seam needed outside core.

options.title: Close as out of scope
options.body: Reject per-user accounting in core because the Gateway remains a one-operator control plane rather than a multi-tenant billing boundary.

recommendation.title: Design core user accounting first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned design that chooses the identity key, retention model, access rules, and core dashboard/API scope before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the newest usage API/dashboard implementation and are best positioned to judge whether this belongs in that pipeline or outside core.
